## Figure A — Real OISST SST Climatology with EAC Pathway

SST data: NOAA OISST V2.1, annual mean 2015 (12 monthly snapshots).
Load the CSV file `oisst_annual_mean_seaus.csv` — place it in the same
folder as this Rmd before knitting.

```{r load-sst}
# Load pre-processed OISST data
# Source: NOAA OISST V2.1 (https://www.ncei.noaa.gov)
# Annual mean computed from monthly snapshots across 2015
sst_mean <- read.csv("oisst_annual_mean_seaus.csv")

cat("SST grid cells:", nrow(sst_mean), "\n")
cat("SST range:", round(min(sst_mean$sst), 1), "to",
    round(max(sst_mean$sst), 1), "°C\n")
```

```{r eac-pathway}
# EAC pathway schematic
# Based on Suthers et al. (2011) and Holbrook & Bindoff (1997)
eac_main <- data.frame(
  lon = c(151.0, 153.5, 154.5, 155.0, 154.5, 154.0, 153.0, 152.0, 151.5, 151.5),
  lat = c(-22.0, -24.0, -26.0, -28.0, -30.0, -32.0, -34.0, -36.0, -38.0, -40.0)
)

eac_extension <- data.frame(
  lon = c(153.0, 152.5, 151.5, 151.0, 150.5, 149.5, 149.0),
  lat = c(-34.0, -36.0, -38.0, -40.0, -41.0, -42.0, -43.5)
)

eac_separation <- data.frame(
  lon = c(153.0, 154.5, 156.0, 158.0),
  lat = c(-34.0, -34.5, -35.0, -36.0)
)
aus <- ne_countries(country = "Australia",
                    scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
```

```{r sst-map, fig.width=6, fig.height=8, fig.cap="**Figure 3.** Annual mean sea surface temperature (SST) along the east Australian coast (NOAA OISST V2.1, 2015). White arrows indicate the approximate pathway of the East Australian Current (EAC) and its southward extension (dashed), which transports warm, nutrient-poor water toward Tasmania. The EAC is one of the fastest-warming ocean regions globally, warming at approximately three to four times the global average (Holbrook & Bindoff, 1997; Suthers et al., 2011). EAC pathway schematic based on Suthers et al. (2011)."}

p_sst <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(
    data = sst_mean,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = sst),
    interpolate = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours  = c("#053061", "#2166ac", "#4393c3", "#92c5de",
                 "#fddbc7", "#f4a582", "#d6604d", "#b2182b", "#67001f"),
    name     = "Mean annual\nSST (°C)",
    na.value = "white",
    limits   = c(11, 27),
    breaks   = seq(12, 26, 4)
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = aus, fill = "#d4c5a9", colour = "#8a7560",
          linewidth = 0.4) +
  # EAC main current
  geom_path(
    data  = eac_main,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2, lineend = "round",
    linejoin = "round",
    arrow  = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"), type = "closed", ends = "last")
  ) +
  # EAC extension toward Tasmania
  geom_path(
    data  = eac_extension,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.9, linetype = "dashed",
    lineend = "round",
    arrow  = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed", ends = "last")
  ) +
  # EAC eastward separation
  geom_path(
    data  = eac_separation,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dotted",
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 153.5, y = -36.5,
         label = "EAC separation\n(~34°S)",
         colour = "white", size = 2.5, fontface = "italic",
         lineheight = 0.85, hjust = 0) +
  # Bass Strait box
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = 143.5, xmax = 150.5, ymin = -40.5, ymax = -38.5,
           fill = NA, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6,
           linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 146.5, y = -38.7, label = "Bass Strait",
           colour = "white", size = 2.6, fontface = "italic") +
  # Labels
  annotate("text", x = 150.5, y = -21,
           label = "East Australian\nCurrent (EAC)",
           colour = "white", size = 3.0, fontface = "bold",
           lineheight = 0.85, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 151.8, y = -39.8,
           label = "EAC Extension\n(warm, nutrient-poor)",
           colour = "white", size = 2.5, fontface = "italic",
           lineheight = 0.85, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 145.0, y = -42.3,
           label = "Tasmania", colour = "grey20", size = 3.5,
           fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 142.5, y = -37.5,
           label = "Victoria", colour = "grey20", size = 3.0,
           fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 139.5, y = -34.5,
           label = "South\nAustralia", colour = "grey20", size = 2.8,
           fontface = "italic", lineheight = 0.85) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(138, 158), ylim = c(-45, -20), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(140, 158, 4),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x, "\u00b0E"),
                     name   = "Longitude") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-44, -20, 4),
                     labels = function(y) paste0(abs(y), "\u00b0S"),
                     name   = "Latitude") +
  labs(
    caption = paste0("Source: NOAA OISST V2.1 annual mean (2015).\n",
                     "EAC pathway schematic based on Suthers et al. (2011) ",
                     "and Holbrook & Bindoff (1997).")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.caption      = element_text(size = 7, colour = "#888888", hjust = 0),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "#cde8f0", colour = NA),
    panel.grid        = element_line(colour = "#b0cfd8", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    plot.margin       = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

p_sst
```

## Figure B — North-south SST Transect

Extract a north-south transect from the real OISST data along the
east Australian coast (149–152°E).

```{r sst-transect, fig.width=8, fig.height=4, fig.cap="**Figure 4.** North-south gradient in mean annual sea surface temperature (SST) extracted from a 149–152°E transect of the NOAA OISST V2.1 dataset (2015). The dashed horizontal line indicates the approximate thermal tolerance threshold for giant kelp (~18°C; Harden et al., 2024). Vertical dashed lines delineate approximate regional boundaries. SST decreases from north to south, with North Tasmanian sites consistently warmer than Southeast Tasmanian sites, reflecting the southward influence of the EAC."}

transect_sst <- sst_mean %>%
  filter(lon >= 149, lon <= 152) %>%
  group_by(lat) %>%
  summarise(sst = mean(sst, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(lat) %>%
  filter(lat >= -45, lat <= -34)

p_sst_transect <- ggplot(transect_sst, aes(x = lat, y = sst)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-38.5, -40.5, -42.5),
             colour = "grey70", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 11, ymax = sst), fill = "#f4a582", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(colour = "#d6604d", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(colour = "#b2182b", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 18, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "#67001f", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = -34.5, y = 18.3,
           label = "~18\u00b0C thermal tolerance threshold (Harden et al., 2024)",
           size = 2.4, colour = "#67001f", hjust = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = -36.5, y = 11.5, label = "VIC",
           size = 2.8, colour = "grey40", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = -39.5, y = 11.5, label = "N TAS",
           size = 2.8, colour = "grey40", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = -41.5, y = 11.5, label = "NE TAS",
           size = 2.8, colour = "grey40", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = -43.5, y = 11.5, label = "SE TAS",
           size = 2.8, colour = "grey40", fontface = "italic") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-44, -34, 2),
    labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "\u00b0S"),
    name   = "Latitude"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name   = "Mean annual SST (\u00b0C)",
    limits = c(11, 27)
  ) +
  labs(
    caption = paste0("Transect averaged across 149\u2013152\u00b0E. ",
                     "Source: NOAA OISST V2.1 (2015).")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.caption     = element_text(size = 7, colour = "#888888", hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin      = margin(5, 10, 5, 5)
  )

p_sst_transect
```
